events.title: 🐝 The Bees Are Ready to Serve You !
events.summary: The Beehive Simulator demo is now available !You can now discover the world of Beehive Simulator and start building your very own bee colony.The goal of this demo is primarily to give you a first technical preview of the game and gather your feedback. You can share your thoughts directly through the Steam Community Hub, or through the Discord server, where it will be easier to discuss the game and exchange ideas.Of course, if you enjoy the demo, don't forget to add the game to your wishlist ! ❤️

events.title: 🐝 The Bees Are Starting to Leave the Hive !
